title: 2026 Annual General Meeting Held at The Wells Church: Minutes & Documents
author: The Friends of the Commons Secretariat
photo_credit: Photo: Kelly Wilcox • March for the Commons (21 March 2026)
summary: Members gathered on 2nd September 2026 to review the charity’s annual accounts, receive conservation reports from volunteer work parties, and vote on trustee elections. Download the official signed meeting minutes.
body:
On Wednesday, 2nd September 2026, The Friends of Tunbridge Wells and Rusthall Commons convened their Annual General Meeting (AGM) at The Wells Church in Tunbridge Wells.

Members gathered to receive formal reports from the Trustees on the charity’s annual activities, review the audited accounts for the financial year, and discuss strategic developments surrounding the ongoing community campaign to acquire the freehold of the Commons.

### Key Business & Resolutions
- **Conservation Progress:** Review of extensive practical work across 256 acres including Marlpit pond clearance and path repairs.
- **Financial & Audit Review:** Approval of annual financial accounts.
- **Campaign Strategy:** In-depth update on the freehold campaign and negotiations.
- **Trustee Elections:** Members voted to elect the executive officers and board of trustees.
